description: Applies the width/height previously copied into DiagramClipboard to the selected nodes. Undoable — Undo() restores each node's original size.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Applies the change to the document.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Restores the state captured before Execute() ran.

examples.title: Use PasteSizeCommand
examples.code:
new CopyStyleCommand(sourceNode, includeSize: true).Execute();

commandStack.Push(new PasteSizeCommand(document, selectedNodeIds));
